source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第七节

textbook_summary: Low potassium may augment P and widen QRS; no concentration threshold is implemented.
composition: Reuse reference QRS shape at longer support and recompute smooth terminal ST onset. Preserve ST levels, intrinsic T/U, optional inversion/overlap, events and mechanical offset.
limitations: One fixed illustration, not bundle-block or concentration model
No derived perfusion impairment or automatic rhythm transition
